Name: XdrLogRaider
Author: Alex Kefallonitis - al.kefallonitis@gmail.com
Description: The **XdrLogRaider** Microsoft Sentinel solution provides a data connector that harvests the `security.microsoft.com/apiproxy/*` Microsoft Defender XDR portal-internal surface (Action Center, Configuration, Endpoint Devices, Identity, Multi-Tenant, Secure Score, etc.) that Microsoft does not publicly document. Unattended Service Account TOTP/Passkey sign-in. **No Microsoft SLA** on the /apiproxy/ surface — operator-curated · breaking changes possible. v0.1.0 ships connector + sample queries only · analytic rules + workbooks in v0.2.0.
